reels.caption: HOW TO CREATE THIS 🤯 With @higgsfield.ai, GPT Astra and GENJUTSU, I built this entire sequence while keeping control over the camera movement, environments and characters. First, I connected GPT Astra to Blender and created the scene and camera movements just by describing what I wanted in the chat. Then I used Nano Banana inside Higgsfield to create different environments, materials and character references. Next, I opened GENJUTSU and combined those references with my Blender render using Video-to-Video. Same camera movement. Completely different worlds. Then I connected GPT to After Effects through Higgsfield Bridge. Now I could make changes to the edit just by describing what I wanted in the chat. And because everything was connected remotely, I could even send instructions from my phone while my MacBook handled the work. Blender + GPT + GENJUTSU + After Effects all connected in one workflow. This is actually insane. Et voilà! 🫡 Comment “EPIC” and I’ll send you the full workflow sheet.
